lines.en: Maze-like lines run across my scales.
Six fin-limbs stroke in turn.
I move from the shallows toward deeper water.
My thick lips graze the sandy bottom.
My patterns darken and gleam underwater.
One tailbeat and I turn half around.
Six limbs brace me on a stone.
Water weeds slide past my sides.
I drift along the channel floor.
A little silt puffs into the water.
I slip between two rock gaps.

lines.zh: 身体侧了一点，避开棱角
lines.en: I tilt to clear a jagged edge.
Light falls through the surface onto my back.
I take a breath and my gill cover shuts.
The sand under me is soft.
I rise half a body length.
Hanging in the water, six limbs swaying.
My gills open and close, slowly.

lines.zh: 纹路在暗处几乎看不见
lines.en: In the dark, my patterns almost vanish.
I rub my lips against a stone.
A fish swims past me.
My tail stills.
I watch a shadow on the bottom.
One of my six limbs lifts.
Light wavers on the surface above.
I turn half about toward the crevice.
Bubbles rise from my mouth.
Something moves in the crevice.
I sink a little lower.
The lines on me look like a path.
There's nothing I need to do.
Just floating like this.
I look up at you through the water.
Your shadow lands on the surface.
I turn my head to one side.
My thick lips move.
My patterns shift in the light.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向挪了一点
lines.en: I drift a little your way.
All six limbs point toward the bank.
You're standing in shallow water.
I'm not afraid, and I don't come close.
My eye rolls once.
My tail sways gently.
Seen enough. I sink back down.
The water clouds at once.
A tailbeat takes me back.

lines.zh: 我的纹路缺了一块，很显眼。
lines.en: A gap in my pattern shows plainly.
My patterns blur.
My gill covers pump fast.
One of my limbs stops moving.
I settle onto the sand.
Blood blooms in the water.
I'll remember this.
When I recover.
Something drops onto the water.
I look up and my patterns brighten.
All six limbs stroke that way.
I bite. A little hard.
I decide to try again.
This time it breaks.
Faint taste, but edible.
I pin it against a stone.
It shattered. I pick up the pieces slowly.
This is plenty.
I rise to the surface and settle again.
I gather every crumb from the bottom.
My gill covers work. Content.
This will keep me busy all afternoon.
Try dropping it farther out.
I swim faster than you can throw.

lines.zh: 泥一扬起来，我就看不见你。
lines.en: The silt rises and I lose sight of you.
One tailbeat takes me aside.
Six limbs brace against the bottom.
You stepped on my fin.
I rise to get clear of you.

lines.zh: 石头被我碰得滚了一下
lines.en: My bump sends a stone rolling.
More silt lifts.
I didn't mean to hit you.
Step back and the water clears.
I'll settle somewhere else.
We know each other by our patterns.
Two mazes swim side by side.
Our limbs overlap as we stroke.
I follow her wake.
She presses her lips to mine.

lines.zh: 水底的沙被我们一起搅动
lines.en: Together we stir the sandy floor.
Our patterns line up in the light.
We head for deeper water.
No one disturbs us there.
Floating abreast in silence.
My thick lips close around it.
Crunch, then swallow.
Bits leak past my gills.
One forelimb nudges it.
Pinned under a stone, I eat slowly.
Too small. One bite.
The current takes it away.
Two tries before I caught it.
The taste is ordinary.
Done. Back to floating.
You've entered the water.
I turn square to you.
Six limbs plant in the sand.
My patterns dim all at once.
My movement churns the water.
My gill covers flare wide.

lines.zh: 石头在我脚边翻了个身
lines.en: A stone rolls over by my feet.
I let out something low.
You can barely hear it.
But I've already decided.
I circle around your legs.
The sand below clouds into fog.
Each circle closes in.
Six limbs stroke, beat after beat.
Your shadow is clear to me.
I wait for you to wade deeper.
There you'll slow down.
I muddy the water further.
I can find you without seeing.
My patterns are my map.
I ram my head into your knee.
All six limbs wrap around.
My thick lips clamp your trouser leg.
My tail fin slaps your leg.
The pull drags you off balance.
I can't bite through armor.
You kick me away.
I roll over and swim back.
The water helps me, not you.

lines.zh: 厚唇咬住你的裤管，往下拽。
lines.en: My thick lips clamp your trouser leg and pull.
A shadow appears in the shallows.

lines.zh: 纹路从暗处慢慢显出来
lines.en: My patterns surface out of the dark.
All six limbs brace against the current.
My gill covers work twice.
A little silt lifts.
I lift my head. The light is bright.
This water isn't familiar.
Stone and water. That's enough.
I slip half a length deeper.
One tailbeat steadies me.
The water warms. I dive deeper.
I hit stone and chip a scale.
There isn't enough air in the water.
The blast throws me clear of the water.
Something stabs my flank.
This force scatters my patterns.
Too hungry to move.
The lightning hit the water and I froze.
No water. Nothing at all.
